subject.title: Discord thread reply after session done: silent message loss due to session-store CAS race, no retry unlike Telegram

question: Should this Discord-specific report wait on the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should maintainers require Discord channel-level retry/requeue or visible-failure handling for `reply session initialization conflicted` errors now?
rationale: The source-backed Discord drop path is real, but the open shared self-heal may be the cleaner root fix; choosing the permanent owner boundary affects whether OpenClaw adds channel retry loops or relies on shared session recovery.

options.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
options.body: Treat the open shared self-heal PR as the primary fix path, then retest Discord thread follow-ups before adding a channel-specific retry loop.

options.title: Require Discord Retry Parity
options.body: Queue a Discord repair that classifies reply-session-init conflicts as retryable and preserves the inbound job with bounded backoff or a visible failure.

options.title: Ask For Live Discord Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open while requesting a current-main Discord thread timing repro before choosing between shared-root and channel-level fixes.

recommendation.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
recommendation.body: Treat the open shared self-heal PR as the primary fix path, then retest Discord thread follow-ups before adding a channel-specific retry loop.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has the strongest sampled history on the guarded reply-session initialization boundary where the shared-vs-channel recovery decision sits.
